kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: Odd central element; appears in [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa*gamma(X,Y)

K.label: K
K.role: Even central element; identified with scalar 1 in all current applications

phi_parameters.description: Coefficients of the general odd linear map f: g -> g. f(Z_j) = sum_{Z_i: p(Z_i)!=p(Z_j)} phi_{Z_i,Z_j} * Z_i. Label convention: phi_{output}_{input}.
